precepts.text: The Lord is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble, and he knoweth them that trust in him.
precepts.point: I will render double unto thee: for your shame ye shall have double, everlasting joy, and your seed known among the Gentiles, so that all who see your children acknowledge them as the seed the Lord has blessed. Write the chain of events: awakening, tribulation, World War III, Armageddon where Christ makes his advent, deliverance, wilderness, kings and priests.

note.label: Zionism in the Face of Syria & Hezbollah

precepts.why:
Zechariah says “Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope.” Nahum tells us what that stronghold is: “The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.” The stronghold is the Lord, and that means this Bible.

The verse before in Zechariah speaks of the pit “wherein is no water”, meaning there is no truth. That pit is America, the valley of dry bones of Ezekiel 37. Out of that pit, the prisoners are told to turn to the stronghold.

So turning to the stronghold is turning to the Lord and his word. He is good, he is our strong hold in the day of trouble, and he knows them that trust in him. We are the prisoners of hope, and the Bible calls us that.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
“Affliction shall not rise up the second time.” What does that mean? “Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her”.

When Trump says Make America Great Again: once the Lord takes this place down, it is not going to resurrect itself. It is over and finished. That is not going to happen.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
The wicked counsellor is not just one man; it is a system of people. “I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn”. The horns on the beast represent NATO and the European Union, and the little horn that came up among them is America, “before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots”: Spain in the Spanish-American War, Britain in the war of independence, and France.

Jump to verse 20: “And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look was more stout than his fellows.” America’s look is more stout: greater in power than Spain, France, Britain, Germany and Russia.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
“And in the latter time of their kingdom”, the feet and toes of Daniel 2, “when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.” Although it says king, it is not one person; it is a leadership, a shadow government, a group of people behind the scenes who run everything. Trump is just a figurehead.

“And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power”: the dragon gave him his power, as Revelation 13:2 said. “And shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.” We have been destroyed as a race and a people, scattered from country to country, our power gone.

“And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand”: his policy is his politics, political and religious. “And by peace shall destroy many”: they invited Iran to peace talks in Geneva, and while the ambassador came, America bombed them. Black people always get fooled by peace.

“He shall also stand up against the Prince of princes”: Christ, the King of kings and Lord of lords. “But he shall be broken without hand”, without man’s hands. “For it shall be for many days”: centuries from Daniel until now.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
Christians talk about the Antichrist coming as if it were one man, like Trump. “Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.”

It is not one antichrist but many, just as the wicked counsellor is a system. When people say Christ was a Caucasian, that is antichrist: they reject the Christ with skin like it burned in a furnace and want the blond-haired, blue-eyed leprosy Jesus. The Christ that keeps no commandments is antichrist.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
God made a promise to end this affliction. “Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom”. Edom is the so-called white man and white woman, the pure-blooded Caucasian Europeans. “The cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked”: naked with sin.

“The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion”: the twelve tribes of Israel. “He will no more carry thee away into captivity”: no more slave ships to serve slavery in another country. That is “I will afflict thee no more.”

“He will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.” Now God is going to visit Edom for what they have done.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
What does it mean that no more of their name be sown? Of Babylon: “Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people”, with missiles and bombs; they don’t even care about their own people, as COVID-19 showed. “The seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.” Seed is semen, which is lineage.

“Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities. For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew”. He is going to wipe them out. That is the name no more sown in Nahum 1:14.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
The seed of evildoers is a lineage: “In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.”

The white man has never done righteousness, and he has never loved Jacob, his brother. Those are the children of the devil, the seed of evildoers of Isaiah 14:20, and our people make alliances and allegiance with them to do the same thing.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
“For thou art vile.” God said the same of Antiochus Epiphanes: “And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.” That is what Antiochus did.

The commentaries call Antiochus a precursor to the Antichrist in the last days, and some scholars know that what is written of him is really speaking of America in the last days. Nineveh is vile, Antiochus was vile, and America is vile.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
Why does Nahum name Judah? “The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.”

In Numbers 2, in the formation of Israel’s camp, Judah was put in the front, and there is a reason. God saves Judah first, so that the other tribes do not magnify themselves against Judah.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
Once Judah is raised up, what does Judah do? “And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah”, because Judah would be teaching, “and bring him unto his people”. Judah would identify Benjamin, Levi, Ephraim, Manasseh, Reuben, Gad, Issachar and Naphtali. That was Judah’s lot, and it has been done today.

“Let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.” God is going to help Judah against all his enemies, and we have a lot of enemies.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

precepts.why:
Here is the precept to the feet on the mountains in Nahum 1:15. “How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?” A preacher is a modern word for a prophet. “And how shall they preach, except they be sent?”

That is why the men should get their passports, so they can be sent to teach brothers and sisters who have never heard this truth. It is shadowbanned on YouTube and blocked in country after country, so we must go out and teach.

“How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!” “But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?” The report is the scriptures. “So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.” To increase our faith we must constantly hear what the word of God is saying.

One thing about our people, we do not work well together; the Most High is going to change that whether you like it or not. note.label: Nahum 1: The Burden of Nineveh

points: Nahum prophesied during the Assyrian captivity, the time of Jonah and Tobit. “The burden of Nineveh.” Nineveh was the capital of Assyria, the wicked kingdom. Christianity has never taught you to associate Nineveh with America; you have been taught they are two separate things. They are one and the same.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

points: “The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.” How does he know us that trust in him? He puts us through trials, and a trial proves whether you trust in the Lord. Everybody says I love my neighbour as myself. Then the Lord allows Satan to stir up a brother or sister next to you to get on your nerves, and when it comes time to apply it you give them the finger or start a fist fight. You just failed. People say they won’t come to a congregation because they might not get along with everybody; that means God needs to purge and cleanse you.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

points: “But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.” He is going to make an overrunning flood here in this place.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

points: “What do ye imagine against the Lord? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.” Once the Lord takes this place down, it will not rise again.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

points: “And while they are drunken as drunkards”. Our people are drunk with philosophies, religious ideologies and political groups. Years ago black people were Democrat, Democrat, Democrat; now it is Republican, Republican, Republican.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

points: “There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the Lord, a wicked counsellor.” One out of Nineveh. Don’t look for just one man; it is a system of people.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

points: “Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through.” Many Europeans, cut down. “Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.” God allowed us to go into slavery, and he promises to afflict us no more.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

points: “For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.” The yokes of iron today are not on our necks but on our minds, spirits and souls: Christianity, politics, Baptists, Lutherans, Mormons, concupiscence, lasciviousness and adultery, lie after lie. We are mesmerized, lied to and manipulated by social media. God said he will break those yokes off us.

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

points: “And the Lord hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown”. The thee is Esau, Edom. Today you pay thousands for Gucci, Louis Vuitton, Chanel, Versace and Prada, old family names from the Renaissance; China makes those bags and shoes for three dollars and you buy them for three thousand, keeping their name sown in the earth.

“Out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image”: that is the Vatican. God has promised to destroy the house of their gods and all their graven images. “I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.”

note.label: BLACK ALLIANCE WITH A SHADOW GOVERNMENT

points: “Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace!” The good tidings are the brothers going out teaching. “O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.” Why does he name Judah? Because Judah is raised up first.
